title: Dakhoon (100ml)
body_html:
An opulent fusion inspired by traditional Arabian incense rituals, Oud Arabia – Dakhoon opens with a rich whisper of agarwood, rose, and smooth vanilla that instantly creates a warm, smoky aura. As the fragrance evolves, exotic saffron blends seamlessly with Omani frankincense and sweet praline accords, adding depth and mystery to every note. Anchored by a powerful base of leather, powder musk, and amber, this scent delivers a luxurious oriental experience that feels both bold and timeless. Crafted for those who appreciate deep, resinous fragrances, Dakhoon leaves behind a captivating trail that lingers with elegance and intensity.

title: Coffee Oud (100ml)
body_html:
Bold, addictive, and irresistibly warm — Oud Arabia – Coffee Oud captures the richness of freshly brewed coffee infused with spicy cardamom and a hint of pink pepper for a striking first impression. The heart reveals a comforting blend of cinnamon, mandarin, and caramel, creating a perfect balance between sweetness and spice. As it settles, a deep base of cedarwood, musk, tonka bean, agarwood, and creamy vanilla unfolds, delivering a smooth, long-lasting finish. Designed for lovers of gourmand oriental scents, Coffee Oud wraps you in a sophisticated aroma that feels intense, cozy, and unforgettable.

title: The Dark Horse (100ml)
body_html:
Bold, enigmatic, and crafted for those who stand apart, The Dark Horse opens with a striking burst of lemon, aldehydes, and bergamot wrapped in an intense leathery oud accord. The heart unfolds with vibrant green notes, neroli, and freesia, softened by juicy pear and warm cardamom, creating a perfect balance between freshness and depth. As the fragrance settles, a powerful base of musk mallow, cashmerean, sandalwood, African leather, and smooth musk emerges — leaving behind a dark, confident trail that lasts for hours. Designed as a unisex oil-based blend, The Dark Horse is a statement scent that embodies mystery, strength, and timeless elegance.

title: Jannat E Zuhur (100ml)
body_html:
An extract of 99 types of flower oils will take you on a journey to the gardens of heaven (Jannat) with the first wisp. Made from the world’s finest roses sourced from Grasse (France), which bloom for only 30 minutes a year, the fragrance also features Iranian Taif Rose, Jasmine de Grasse, lilies from the French Highlands, and Bulgarian Rose. It takes 700 kilograms of flowers to produce just 1 kilogram of pure flower oil (Attar), which is used in this exquisite perfume. The scent offers a lasting impression with a longevity of up to 48 hours.
